jsonld_raw.name: (180 G) ORCHIDÉE LUMIÈRE SCENTED CANDLE
jsonld_raw.description:
Scented candle made of vegetable wax.

Orchidèe Lumière | Orchid flowers exude a sensual and mysterious fragrance with hints of black vanilla that envelope an elegant floral bouquet, adding a final touch of rich warmth. 

Notes:
Top notes: citrus cocktail, Italian lemon oil, fruity.
Heart: orchid, Egyptian jasmine, lily of the valley, freesia, gardenia.
Base notes: cedar wood, cedar oil, musk, vanilla.
